title: Play / Resume
description: Send MPRIS resume signal to all active desktop media players

title: Pause Media
description: Send immediate asynchronous pause signal over D-Bus to all active media players

title: Toggle Play / Pause
description: Toggle media playback between playing and paused

title: Next Track
description: Skip to next audio or video track in playlist or queue

title: Previous Track
description: Jump back to previous media track or start of current song

title: Replay Track
description: Restart currently playing song or video track from beginning

title: Seek Forward 10s
description: Fast forward playback position by 10 seconds

title: Seek Backward 30s
description: Rewind playback position backward by 30 seconds
